about_the_game:
Welcome to Groupel, a strategic roguelike where luck is nothing but an illusion… and chance itself becomes a weapon to master.

Each run begins with a handful of chips. Your goal: survive round after round by reaching the required target each time.

But beware — the house doesn’t forgive mistakes. One bad bet, and everything can crumble.

Between rounds, visit the croupier’s shop, a shady yet charming dealer ready to sell you jokers that can rewrite the rules of the game:

multiply your winnings, rig the colors, influence the ball’s path, or bend the odds in your favor.

Build your own synergy, combine effects, and discover unexpected strategies to defy fate.

Every run is unique — new jokers, new challenges, new chaos.

The game adapts to your success: the better you do, the higher the stakes.

You’ll need to take risks, play with probability, and turn your mistakes into opportunities to push your luck further than ever.

🃏 Features

  • 🎯 A reimagined roulette gameplay turned into a strategic roguelike.

  • 💎 Over 100 unique jokers with varied and sometimes absurd effects.

  • 🧩 Endless combinations to craft your own playstyle.

  • 🛒 A mysterious shop, filled with shady deals and tempting offers.

  • 🎵 A rich casino atmosphere — roulette spins, whispers, and clinking glasses.

  • 💀 Progressive difficulty where fortune favors the bold.

The question isn’t whether you’ll win…

but how long you’ll last before luck runs out.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Offline play only.
